proof_summary: For \(p\ge7\), finite-field power-sum divisibility, reflection \(k\mapsto p-k\), and truncated product identities give \(\binom{3p}{p}\equiv3+6pH_1-6p^2H_2\) and the squared-binomial sum \(\equiv3+6pH_1+10p^3T\pmod{p^5}\), where \(T=\sum_{k=1}^{p-1}H_{k-1}/k^2\). Further harmonic, alternating-binomial, and Vandermonde identities show both corrections are divisible by \(p^3\) and their weighted linear combination \(4c+3s\) vanishes modulo \(p^5\), so all nonlinear terms also vanish; the primes \(3\) and \(5\) are handled by direct computation.
